candidate.originalEvidence: WMF record parsers validate size2 <= remaining bytes (metafile.rs:477-489) but all payload reads use whole data, never off..off+size2. META_TEXTOUT (614-619) permits a size=4-word (8-byte) record carrying n=65535, then reads text and coordinates from following records; off advances only 8 bytes (684). Repeating these short records makes overlapping ~64KiB strings retained as MetaText per record (wmf_text 692-715, texts Vec 474) -> ~8GiB strings from ~1MiB WMF before layout. META_EXTTEXTOUT (603-610), POLYGON (628-639), POLYPOLYGON (644-660), POLYLINE (663-679) similarly cross record boundaries. EMF read_emf_points correctly bounds p against off+size (1061-1082), useful counterevidence. No app execution/input construction done.

candidate.originalEvidence: DOCX admission ignores Event::DocType (src/admission.rs:795-819; Ok(_) => {}), while permissive DOM parse_document skips any ' (src/xmllinq/parse.rs:539-543) and recursively parses remaining '<' elements (550-552, 562, 660-663) with no depth cap. Permissive parser skips to ELEMENT's >, then skips to first 's > inside ENTITY, then recurses into remaining '' tags, causing stack overflow before document root. WmlDocument::from_bytes admission (src/wml_document.rs:50-58) -> main_document parse_xdocument (94-102) gives supported entry point. Strict validate_xml rejects DTD but WmlDocument route uses admission and unchecked parse. Verifying dependency DocType scanning statically now; no code execution.
